metaTitle: Buy specialty coffee online in Colombia
metaDescription: Roasted specialty coffee from Colombian family farms, roasted to order and delivered across Colombia. Free shipping over COP 150,000.
title: Roasted coffee,
description: Bags roasted by the families who grow the coffee. Buy directly from their brands, for your home or your café.

perks.title: Roasted to order
perks.text: Bags leave the farm within days of roasting

perks.title: Pay your way
perks.text: PSE, Nequi and cards are coming soon

perks.title: Direct to families
perks.text: Each sale goes to the producer brand

brands.title: Shop by
brands.text: Every brand here belongs to a coffee family. They grow it, roast it and sell it under their own name.

catalog.title: Find
catalog.emptyText: Try removing a filter to see the whole shop.
catalog.note: Example products and brands for this design preview. Prices are not real offers.

club.name: Coffee club
club.title: A new farm
club.text: One freshly roasted bag from a different producer each month, with the story of the family behind it. Pause or cancel anytime.
club.note: Example price. We confirm your first box on WhatsApp.
club.message: Hi! I'd like to join the coffee club (one bag from a different producer each month). Can you tell me how to start?

quiz.title: Not sure which to pick?
quiz.text: Tell us how you brew, moka pot, filter or espresso, and we'll suggest a coffee.
quiz.message: Hi! Help me choose a coffee. I brew with: (moka pot / filter / espresso). I like: (fruity / chocolatey / sweet).

delivery.title: From the farm

steps.title: Order your bags
steps.text: Mix coffees from different producers in one cart and finish your order on WhatsApp. Online payment with PSE, Nequi and cards is coming soon.

steps.title: Roasted and packed
steps.text: Each producer roasts and packs your bags at the farm, then hands them to the courier.

steps.title: At your door in 1 to 5 days
steps.text: Flat shipping of COP 12,000 anywhere in Colombia, free on orders over COP 150,000.

delivery.citiesNote: Example times for this preview, to be confirmed with the courier.
delivery.legal: Right of withdrawal and PQRS: terms to be confirmed after legal review.

sell.title: Do you roast
sell.text: Open your shop here and sell your bags to homes and cafés across Colombia. We handle orders, you keep your brand.

notice.title: The shop ships inside
notice.description: Our roasted coffee is sent to addresses in Colombia. Outside Colombia, you can still buy the green coffee itself.
notice.panelText: Traceable lots from named family farms in Urrao, with a free 200 g sample for verified buyers before you commit to a box.
